Subject: [spambayes-dev] spambayes crash due to bad image

I got this crash, probably due to a bad image.  The code in ImageStripper.py that calls PIL is currently in a except IOError, but should probably be in a bare except to catch any and all errors from PIL.  In my case I got an IndexError.
